newsitem.title: LEBANON: Banks lead Beirut market quietly upwards.
newsitem.headline: Banks lead Beirut market quietly upwards.

text.p: Banque Audi and Bank of Beirut led the Beirut Stock Exchange upwards in quiet trade on Friday.

Banque Audi hit a new high of $23.25 from $23.125, bringing its increase since listing in January to 55 percent, and BOB rose to $3.937 from $3.875. The third listed bank, Banque Beirut pour le Commerce, fell back to $18 from $18.25.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.25 percent to 153.78, the LISPI general index rose 0.07 percent to 89.42 and the BLOM general index rose 0.03 percent to 932.14.

There were no changes in other shares, of which only three were traded. Ciments Libanais was unchanged at $1.28125 on turnover of 2,000 shares and Solidere A and B were unchanged on strong demand at $10.5 and $10.75.
There was no trade in the three other companies: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
Turnover fell sharply to 93,651 shares from 205.695 on Thursday and value fell to $1,277,153 from $1,876,994.
